## New
- Optional Smart Downloads choose offline songs from your likes, replays, saved songs and music preferences.
- Choose Wi-Fi or any network and an optional charging-only rule in the app. These rules apply to actual file transfers as well as suggestion checks.
- Select a 10, 20 or 50 song limit, with up to five additions per check and battery/storage checks.
- Existing files are never automatically deleted. Switching off stops new selections and leaves queued downloads visible in Downloads.

## Improved
- Automatic suggestions skip existing downloads, dislikes, blocked artists and repeatedly skipped songs.
- Recently removed suggestions wait seven days before they can be automatically added again.
